description: Native lane: build broader v2 search-aware move-choice targets before the next objective change.
hypothesis: Native scratch/continuation failures are dominated by broad non-mate/stable move-choice loss. Before another training run, build a broader top-N target set that includes pairwise SPRT-fail positions in addition to the current stable/repeated/SPRT scored move CSVs.

required_checks: build full and deduped v2 JSONL target files
report targets, move rows, source distribution, tag distribution
do not train until the target distribution is reviewed
validation.next: target build only; no training and no SPRT
